d: We are looking to hire an HR Manager – HR Operations & Talent Acquisition based in Riyadh. This role will be responsible for building and managing Atheer's in-house HR function, overseeing day-to-day HR operations, employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, government platform administration, and end-to-end recruitment for both business and technical positions.

This role will manage onboarding and offboarding, compliance activities, employee services, payroll preparation, Saudization monitoring, and medical insurance administration. On the recruitment side, they will partner with hiring managers, source senior and specialized talent, manage interviews and assessments, and drive hiring processes through successful onboarding.
q: 1-3 years of HR experience in Saudi Arabia covering both HR Operations and Recruitment.
Practical experience with Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and Mudad.
Strong understanding of Saudi labor regulations, payroll processes, and Wage Protection System requirements.
Proven success recruiting senior-level, senior leadership, and technical talent.
Experience within technology, telecommunications, or high-growth organizations.
Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English.

Experience launcing employee performance review cycles.
Ability to manage annual workforce planning and HR budgeting.

d: The “Lead Compliance and Control” is responsible for the implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of robust compliance and control frameworks. Entrusted with overseeing and driving the company's adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies and procedures, and industry best practices. Thereby safeguarding QDF reputation and minimizing operational risks by delivering comprehensive compliance programs, conducting regular assessments, and providing pre-emptive guidance. Play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct across all business functions. Will be instrumental in identifying potential areas of vulnerability, proactively mitigating compliance risks, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives to uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and compliance within the organization.

Develop and implement compliance policies and procedures collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop, review and enhance compliance policies, procedures and controls tailored to the unique environment and operational landscape of Qatar Duty Free.

Handle compliance monitoring and reporting by conducting regular assessments and audits to monitor the company's adherence to applicable policies, procedures, ensuring timely and accurate reporting to Senior and Executive Management.

Facilitate risk assessment and mitigation by Identifying, assessing and prioritizing compliance, operational, financial, fraud and/or reputational risks associated with business activities, products and services, and develop strategies and action plans to mitigate these risks effectively.

Support internal and external audit programs through engaging and supporting internal, external and state auditors and ensuring timely submission of required information and documentation by liaising with relevant stakeholders and departments.

Facilitate trainings and awareness programs in partnership with QDFC Training department to design and deliver comprehensive compliance training and awareness programs for employees at all levels to promote a culture of compliance, integrity, and ethical behavior throughout the organization.

Responsible for Investigations and remediation by leading or supporting investigations into potential compliance breaches, conflicts of interest, or unethical behavior, and recommend corrective actions and remediation measures to address identified issues and prevent recurrence.

Promote Internal controls enhancements by continuously evaluating and enhancing internal control mechanisms and procedures to strengthen the company's risk management framework and improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Stay abreast of changes in regulatory requirements, industry trends, and emerging risks affecting the travel retail industry, and advise senior management on potential impacts and required actions to maintain compliance. Driving Change Management.

Handle stakeholder engagement by fostering collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, regulatory agencies and external partners to exchange best practices, share insights, and understand emerging developments relevant to the business.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the compliance function by identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and innovation to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of the compliance operations.

d: Are you ready to take the next step in your career?

Uni-Fuels (NASDAQ:UFG) is a global provider of marine fuel to shipping companies around the world. We integrate supply logistics and tailored solutions to help our customers optimize their marine fuel procurement covering all markets across all time zones. Founded in 2021, Uni-Fuels has grown from modest beginnings into a dynamic and thriving company with offices in 6 locations and growing.

Manage full set of accounts (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, etc.).
Prepare and reconcile financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
Assist in financial analysis to support management decision-making, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.

Prepare corporate tax returns and ensure compliance with UAE tax laws.
Prepare VAT returns and ensure timely and accurate VAT reporting.
Assist with internal and external audits, ensuring proper documentation and compliance.
Track and manage project-related costs, including budgets and forecasts.
Generate, process, and follow up on client invoices.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable to ensure timely payments.
Coordinate with clients and vendors regarding any discrepancies in invoices.
Process monthly payroll for employees, ensuring compliance with UAE labor laws.

Prepare and maintain payroll records and reports.
Manage and process payments to vendors, suppliers, and contractors.

Reconcile payment transactions and maintain accurate records.
Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure sufficient funds for payments.
Monitor and manage daily cash flow to ensure the company’s liquidity and financial health.
Perform monthly bank reconciliations, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately.
Track and manage outstanding incoming and outgoing payments to maintain cash flow efficiency.
Coordinate with the finance team to forecast cash needs and ensure funds are available for business operations.

Prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence as required.
Maintain and update company records, both digital and physical.
Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and financial tracking.

Ensure alignment with global accounting standards and company procedures.
